data.title: Archive V3 neural research, controlled validation and reproducibility
data.body:
This closes the V3 neural research campaign and archives its actual negative validation result. The selected deployment copy is the byte-identical historical V2 Deep Sets checkpoint; neither locked new finalist met the preregistered replacement rule. The formal score deadline was missed. No V3 official test, score update, or replacement of the original Issue #294 assets was performed.

The implementation adds compact TabM and RealMLP-inspired models, controlled AdamW/Muon/EMA comparisons, objective/decoder and reduced-input ablations, resumable experiments, strict provenance, and inference/export checks. There are 35 complete new configurations (105 outer fits) on the common nested question folds, compared with 19 preserved V2 configurations. All four fixed probability mixtures were rejected. Four additional-seed jobs were pruned without complete CV; original monitoring gaps and elapsed-budget overshoots are disclosed rather than called uninterrupted execution or stable seed results.

Locked validation: reduced TabM EMA 735/798 (hard 292/355), Attention EMA 736/798 (293/355), retained historical Deep Sets 740/798 (297/355). Confidence calibration changed no choices and worsened validation ECE. Complete tables, failures, paired uncertainty, source references and substantive AI assistance are included in the 10-page English closeout and Chinese guide.

Validation and audit evidence:
- All 798 Torch/NumPy export choices match; isolated NumPy-only contract and independent source/asset review passed.
- An anonymous public checkout of immutable source eee478b4959e555b6ec8c902b6db8b69f31df508 and a new three-package environment reproduced all 798 choices and 740/798. Fresh prediction plus separate official scoring took 2.2803908 seconds locally; sampled task threads 4, scientific pools 1, assets 963,670 bytes. This is not reference-Xeon certification.
- The original provenance coordinator intentionally depends on original training-state records. Portable official validation commands are separately documented and actually checked without train data/states; this used the preserved clean environment, not a second installation or a selected faster benchmark.
- Latest report checks: 18 original aggregate tests and 13 closeout tests passed. All 10 delivered pages were rendered and inspected. Earlier report attempts and engineering failures remain available.

The archive freeze explicitly has research_only=true and formal_test_allowed=false. Current final-report tools never fabricate TEST_COMPLETE or relax the formal deadline. Original V1/V2 freezes, logs and search guards remain preserved.

Separate authorized peer review: exact submitted checkpoint #240 was reproduced with the official scorer; the report was created and read back as [course Issue #383](https://github.com/xudongwu-0/xudongwu-0.github.io/issues/383). Installation workaround, recovered cache-probe postcheck and missing combined monotonic timing are disclosed; no prediction/scoring rerun occurred. Its outcome did not feed back into this closed research.
